newsitem.title: ITALY: VAT still due in Italy car incentive scheme-FinMin.
newsitem.headline: VAT still due in Italy car incentive scheme-FinMin.

text.p: Italians taking advantage of a government incentive to scrap an old car and buy a new one will still have to pay value added tax (VAT), the Finance Ministry said.

In a statement to clarify whether car buyers would be required to pay VAT, the ministry said: "The incentive to people buying a new car does not include a reduction in the VAT taxable base, which will still be determined by the discounted retail price."

The government announced last week it intended to offer incentives to car owners to scrap vehicles older than 10 years and buy new ones through a discount scheme, in an effort to stimulate the flagging car market.
Italian newspapers had queried what this signified for the level of VAT payable on cars bought under the scheme.
